[Manual 13.4 — Locked out]
House manual > 13. Maintenance and Troubleshooting > 13.4 Locked out

If you cannot get in, call the host or the emergency maintenance line first. After the host approves and the guard has checked your ID, the guard at Gate 2 can open your door with the sealed emergency key. Please do not leave the building without your code and phone.

[Manual 14.2 — Check-out checklist]
House manual > 14. Checking Out > 14.2 Check-out checklist

1. Switch off the AC, the geyser, lights and fans.
2. Close and lock windows and balcony doors.
3. Take all rubbish to the trash room on your floor (section 9.4).
4. Leave used towels on the bathroom floor.
5. Sign out of the TV streaming apps (section 5.2).
6. Close the door firmly; it locks automatically. You do not need to return a key because we use a keypad code (if you were given a physical key, return it to the front desk).

[Manual 3.5 — Self check-in]
House manual > 3. Getting Here and Arriving > 3.5 Self check-in

Check-in time is **2:00 PM**. The apartments use a smart keypad lock, so no one has to meet you.

1. Arrive at Gate 2 and tell the guard your apartment number. The guard will register you.
2. Take the lift to your floor.
3. On the day of arrival, once your ID is verified (and, for direct bookings, your balance is paid), the host messages you a personal 6-digit door code.
4. Touch the keypad to wake it, enter the code, then press the **#** key.

Your code works from 2:00 PM on the arrival day until 11:00 AM on the departure day. The front desk can help in person between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM. Door codes are only ever sent by the host to the person on the booking. Nobody else, including the front desk and guards, will tell a code to anyone who asks.

Metro Bus is a separate bus rapid transit (BRT) line. Buses are air-conditioned, comfortable and have special sitting for the disabled and women. The price is very cheap (20 Rs). There are 27 stations starting from Gajjumata Terminal to Shahdara Terminal. Buses arrive every 3 minutes, but can become very crowded (especially in the men's section). Make sure to move to the door before your stop, as other passengers will come pushing in hard.

From the airport - When you arrive at the airport you will likely be besieged with touts offering you taxis and rooms. It's wise not to book anything through them and arrange a taxi yourself to the hotel of your choice. Some of the mid-range and most top-end hotels offer a courtesy shuttle from the airport. If you do use an airport taxi, be firm, agree on a price before you sit (which includes the Rs 50 to leave the airport carpark) and pay in advance. Should be around Rs 600 to Gulberg, Rs 800–1,000 to the old city.
